locationUsage: Islamic Day Dial uses your location to calculate accurate prayer times.
appBody: Islamic Day Dial is on the App Store for iPhone, with an Apple Watch companion and an iPhone Home Screen widget. The dial follows the Islamic day from Maghrib to Maghrib and shows the current phase together with the sign to look for.
supportBeforeEmail: Islamic Day Dial is designed for iPhone, Apple Watch companion use, and the iPhone widget. If you need help, contact
privacyBody: Location access is recommended for the most accurate prayer times and phase transitions. On Apple platforms, analytics rely on App Store Connect / App Analytics rather than direct third-party tracking from the app.
privacyBeforeEmail: The public web dashboard may use separate website analytics. The Apple app does not require account creation to work. For privacy questions, contact
cue.fajr: If the sky is brightening, it is Fajr time.
cue.sunrise: Watch the horizon. Has the sun begun to rise?
cue.duha: Look at the sun. Has the morning light clearly spread?
cue.midday: The sun is at its highest point, and shadows are at their shortest. It is Midday.
cue.dhuhr: If the sun has passed the zenith and shadows have started to grow again, it is Dhuhr time.
cue.asr: Asr starts when the shadow length equals the object's height plus its noon shadow.
cue.maghrib: If the sun has gone down, Maghrib time has begun.
cue.isha: Isha starts when the last twilight has disappeared.
cue.lastThird: The last third of the night is here. Isha lasts from Maghrib to Fajr.
cue.jumuah: Take a bath, use perfume, dress well, and remain silent during the khutbah.
cue.eidFitr: Eid al-Fitr prayer time has started.
cue.eidAdha: Eid al-Adha prayer time has started.
cue.eidAccept: May Allah accept [this worship] from you and us!
technical.dhuhr.heading: Dhuhr calculation
technical.dhuhr.start: at solar noon (zawal), calculated by the Adhan library at the user’s coordinates.
technical.asr.heading: Asr calculation
technical.asr.start: when shadow length = object height + noon shadow (at the user’s coordinates).
technical.maghrib.heading: Maghrib calculation
technical.maghrib.start: at sunset, when the sun disappears below the horizon (at the user’s coordinates).
technical.isha.heading: Isha calculation
technical.isha.start: when the evening twilight disappears, using the Adhan model with Shafaq Ahmer and a 15° sun angle (at the user’s coordinates).
technical.fajr.heading: Fajr calculation
technical.fajr.start: calculated according to Umm al-Qura, 18.5° (at the user’s coordinates).
technical.sunrise.heading: Sunrise calculation
technical.sunrise.start: calculated with the Adhan library (at the user’s coordinates), using the standard apparent solar altitude of −50 arcminutes (≈ −0.83°).
technical.duha.heading: Duha calculation
technical.duha.start: when the sun reaches 4° altitude above the horizon (at the user’s coordinates); if needed, fallback = 20 minutes after Sunrise.
technical.midday.heading: Midday calculation
technical.lastThird.heading: Last 3rd calculation
technical.lastThird.start: time between last Maghrib and Fajr divided by 3.
